segment: Expo Park/USC to Culver City (Metro E Line)
corridor_extent_definition: Along-reference span between minimum and maximum retained moving samples; not a sum of repeat travel distances.

grouping_sensitivity.status: Sensitivity scenarios, not alternative observed truth. Normalized window scores retained; grouping and downstream thresholds recomputed.

audit_status: Recomputed by travel direction; pass identities inferred, physical tracks unverified
pending_confirmation: Whether Arjan’s 10:07 eastbound export was a separate train pass or has a clock offset; currently treated as a separate timestamp/GPS group.

method.across_pass_bin: median across covering passes of one direction
method.elevated_threshold: top decile of each pass’s covered bin scores
method.candidate_rule: At least 2 covered passes, at least 2 elevated passes, elevated fraction >= 2/3, directional median score >= 1.5. Adjacent qualifying bins merge; counts refer to peak slice.
method.claim: Places worth inspecting; not diagnoses of broken rails.
method.geometry: Both directional views use the supplied GTFS corridor reference. No surveyed rail or track assignment is inferred.
